study.question: Does binding elapsed-time gap bins to adjacent recurrence retain predictive information lost when all supported edges in the same target-match/action cell are pooled? Source inspection: the incumbent sorts by age, but discards edge durations after choosing adjacency. The preceding order/pairing factorial is inconsistent: chronological joint AUC 0.6214969348, exchangeable joint 0.6218776973, chronological product 0.6218837031, exchangeable product 0.6215240127. This is a consequential unresolved interaction, not evidence that chronology is uniformly helpful.
study.hypothesis: Immediate and delayed repeated category/brand bucket pairs may have different associations with click probability even at identical directed target-match/action states. Explicit gap-conditioned count tables expose that association without new events or learned event scoring. A full time-association x pair-equality replacement factorial tests this mechanism; neither a gain over the parent alone nor synthetic distinguishability establishes predictive usefulness.

study.proposed_difference: Append a bias-free 4096->16->1 residual after all 17,187,571 parent parameters, adding 65,552 (total expected 17,253,123). On exactly the parent complete-pair singleton support, count four equality marks (all, category same, brand same, pair same) across four gap bins (0,60], (60,3600], (3600,86400], >86400 seconds and 256 directed states. Every mode computes actual counts, gap-factorized counts and both conditional pair products. Select a 2x2 readout, flatten and log1p/log129. All-tied, missing, empty and zero-length histories produce zero new features/residual. Ties remain excluded, not invented or arbitrarily ordered. Parent diagnostic mean support 101.6816 of 118.1152 complete events; about 16.4336 tied events are excluded. This is an explicit scope limitation and alternative next question. New head uses no timestamps beyond supplied age. Novelty beyond this local source difference remains unverified; registry searches for time and sequence found no additional papers, and no comprehensive temporal-method priority search is claimed.
predictions: With seed 42 and all fixed inputs/recipe, gap_joint will exceed independent_joint in full-population validation AUC if gap/equality binding is useful. gap_product versus independent_product determines whether the effect survives without observed pair equality; Logloss and measured cost must also be reported.

A gap-specific joint mechanism predicts positive interaction (AUC gap_joint - AUC gap_product) - (AUC independent_joint - AUC independent_product); no sign is assumed established from the previous inconsistent factorial.

Count oracle and raw-margin diagnostic errors should be <=1e-4 (float32 replacement roundoff); exact count errors should be zero. Both replacement margins are preserved before log1p. Four bins sum to parent edge counts.

Synthetic time witness preserves incumbent logits and independent-time features, but changes observed-time features. Pair witness preserves incumbent logits and product-pair features but changes observed-pair features. Checkpoint added-logit gaps can still be zero if the learned head ignores available information.

Exploratory full-validation host slices will include frozen history length/empty, hour, behavior presence and training-frequency bins with sample/positive/negative counts. The dominant history_gt64 group has 3,026,583 impressions; small slices remain exploratory. No unsupported slice significance claim or custom holdout feedback.
falsifiers: No positive observed-minus-independent AUC contrast at either pairing level undermines the elapsed-time-binding explanation for this implementation; a parent-only gain is insufficient. Repeated null results after meaningful support/learning checks would strengthen this conclusion.
Joint versus product pairing fails to improve, or factorial interaction changes sign under paired repetitions: reject stable gap-specific joint recurrence claims.
Independent-time variants also distinguish the time witness, product variants distinguish the pair witness, or parent witness logits differ >1e-4: information contrast is invalid until diagnosed.

Oracle, support, raw-margin conservation, mask/padding, identity-renaming or input-reordering errors >1e-4; nonfinite logits or forbidden input use invalidate assessment rather than count as scientific counterevidence.
Greater latency/training cost with no quality frontier improvement falsifies an efficiency claim. No efficiency or performance gain is claimed before host measurement.
alternative_explanations: Gap distributions encode user activity or missing-data timing rather than recurrence binding; the independent-time control retains those distributions within each directed state cell.

New capacity, residual optimization or global joint counts drive a parent gain; equally allocated factorial replacements, exact parent initialization and existing parent receipt reduce but do not eliminate these explanations.
Sparse directed-state x gap cells and nonlinear fractional replacements change effective feature scale/rank; parameter matching alone cannot isolate all conditioning effects.

Timestamp resolution and exclusion of tied events remove useful rapid behavior. Filtering bridges excluded events; this branch does not measure raw-log transition rates or causal behavioral influence.

History truncation, hashed identities, unknown static snapshot as-of dates, single-seed checkpoint selection and repeated adaptive validation use limit transfer and uncertainty. Supplied histories cannot support older-history or item-level claims.

cost_plan.stop_rule: Do not launch training in this coding phase. Host executes the registered suite. No retry after unknown execution state without a receipt. Before any further proposal, reread remaining budget and receipts; keep attribution+assessment reserves after counted preparation, full suite costs and failures. Stop if no complete admissible experiment fits or integrity fails. Null outcomes are valid; never raise the budget.
